title: FLA import: gradient spreadMode and interpolation silently dropped
description:
File: packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts lines 1336-1339.

Bug: In readFillStyle(), when a Flash 8 gradient fill is read (caps=true path), the code reads the focal byte but then calls r.skip(7) which consumes all 7 remaining bytes of the F8 gradient extras block without ever reading the 'flow|linearRGB' byte. The comment in that code block explicitly identifies this byte: 'focal*255, 0,0,0, flow|linearRGB, 0,0,0'.

The flow byte encodes both the gradient spread mode (bits 6-7: 0=pad/extend, 1=reflect, 2=repeat) and the interpolation mode (bit 4: 0=rgb, 1=linearRGB), but it is silently skipped.

Consequence: Fla8Fill for linear-gradient and radial-gradient has no spreadMode or interpolation field (the type union at line 84-101 confirms this). The toFill() function in flash8-import.ts therefore cannot pass these values to the model's LinearGradientFill or RadialGradientFill, so any FLA gradient with reflect/repeat spread mode or linearRGB interpolation silently renders as pad/rgb (the default) in the exported SWF.

Fix:
1. In flash8-binary.ts readFillStyle(): replace r.skip(7) with: r.skip(3); const flowByte = r.u8(); r.skip(3); and include the decoded spread/interp in the returned Fla8Fill type.
2. Add spreadMode and interpolation fields to the gradient variant of Fla8Fill.
3. In flash8-import.ts toFill(): map the new fields to the model's LinearGradientFill.spreadMode and RadialGradientFill.interpolation.

Acceptance: Import a Flash 8 FLA containing a shape with a reflect-spread radial gradient; compile and export SWF; Ruffle shows the gradient with reflect spread (visible repeated pattern beyond the gradient endpoint).
